name: Wired Business

sources.title: Submit your Website — Free (badge backlink required, 72h review) vs Pro $29 one-time instant publish; ~2,100 sites listed

conditions: Free plan requires placing a Wired Business badge/backlink on your homepage or footer
Free listings are reviewed and listed within 72 hours
Pro ($29 one-time, advertised 30% off with code FROGDR → $20.30) publishes instantly, is permanent, and needs no reciprocal backlink
requirements: A live website to list — directory advertises a 'permanent DR 77 dofollow backlink'
Free tier requires the badge/backlink placed before the 72-hour review completes
Same operator network as Ramen Tools, 500 Tools, Twelve Tools (linked in the footer)
preparation: Product name, URL, description, and category
Ability to add the Wired Business badge/backlink to the site's homepage or footer (free route)
Choose the screenshot to represent the site (editable later via the edit link)
workflow: Open wired.business/submit and choose Free ('Continue') or Pro ('?plan=paid')
Fill in website details and submit
Free path: add the badge/backlink to the site, wait up to 72h for review and the 'website is live' email
Pro path: pay one-time $29; listing publishes immediately
Keep the edit link from the confirmation email for future updates
watchFor: The badge/backlink requirement is the price of the free tier — removing it presumably voids the listing
Reciprocal-badge directories are link schemes in Google's eyes; weigh the DR77 dofollow claim accordingly
Edit link arrives only via the confirmation email/success page — save it
Part of a cluster of near-identical directories (Ramen/500/Twelve Tools) — submissions may be cross-posted
countsAsLive: The listing appears publicly on wired.business (category page) and a 'your website is live' confirmation email arrives
unknowns: Whether the free link is actually dofollow as advertised once live
What happens to free listings if the badge is later removed
